label: late original-phase steps (positions 6-8), content-gated, strongest when sequence starts with a
explanation: Sparse feature (0.16% of steps). All activity is in the last few original-phase positions (orig_idx 5-8, about 96% of mass; t=6-8 dominant) plus weak firing at the <DEL> step. It never fires in the copy phase or at orig_idx <= 3. Position alone is necessary but far from sufficient: only about 1-2% of late original steps fire. Within those steps, firing is enriched when the first original token is a (11x lift, 44% of mass), when the current input is z/e/h, and when the previous input is j. The strongest examples are things like a r x y n j [z]. Restricting to first_tok == a gives dev F1 0.23 (precision 0.19, recall 0.30). The rest of the dependence on content looks like a distributed hidden-state configuration that no simple predicate captures, so the description is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=a (+6.06), orig0=d (+3.65), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=z (+3.63), prev_tok=j (+3.53), orig1=r (+3.33), orig0=r (+3.24). Lower it: phase=2 (-5.60), prev3_tok=- (-5.13), t=3 (-4.90), t=4 (-4.32).
